mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM IDENTITY_VERIFICATION WHERE AGENCY_RESULT_REF = #{agencyResultRef}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO IDENTITY_VERIFICATION (VERIFICATION_ID, ACCOUNT_ID, STATUS, EXPIRES_AT, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{verificationId}, #{accountId}, 'REQUESTED', #{expiresAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE IDENTITY_VERIFICATION SET STATUS = #{status} WHERE VERIFICATION_ID = #{verificationId} AND STATUS = 'REQUESTED'
